# Let-s-Code-India

> Static website for the Let-s-Code-India organization, listing public repositories and project websites.

## Pages
- [Home](https://let-s-code-india.github.io/): Organization website and project directory.
- [Contact](https://let-s-code-india.github.io/contact/): Contact details and reporting links.
- [Privacy Policy](https://let-s-code-india.github.io/privacy/): Browser storage, service requests, and analytics.
- [Terms of Use](https://let-s-code-india.github.io/terms/): Website terms, project licenses, and governing law.
- [Security](https://let-s-code-india.github.io/security/): Private vulnerability reporting and site protections.
- [Licenses](https://let-s-code-india.github.io/licenses/): Site and third-party license attributions.

## Resources
- [GitHub organization](https://github.com/Let-s-Code-India): Public organization profile and repositories.
- [Repository catalog](https://let-s-code-india.github.io/data/repos.json): Generated repository catalog used by the website.
- [security.txt](https://let-s-code-india.github.io/.well-known/security.txt): Security contact and disclosure policy.
